item.title: Video Premiere: Vanta – ‘Alchemy’
item.description: Perth’s Vanta don’t treat melodic death metal like a nostalgia exercise. On their debut full-length Perpetual Selection, the band lean into precision, atmosphere, and sheer velocity—but they’re just as concerned with meaning as they are with impact. The post Video Premiere: Vanta – ‘Alchemy’ appeared first on Decibel Magazine.
